outline:
材料表面工程是工程化之表面覆膜程序，課程內容就基材之特性，介入可能之表面處理方法，包括前處理、厚膜薄膜程序、後處理等，由理論到實際而得 裝飾性、防蝕性與機能性改質之表面，以迎合需求。
The course includes the introduction of the substrate's properties and the possible surface treatment methods. The methods Including pre-treatment, thick film and thin film procedures, post-treatment, etc., from theory to practice to obtain decorative, corrosion-resistant and functionally modified surfaces to meet needs.
